reviewer: Claude (independent read-only review; did not author the fixture; the C shim is Grok's separate review)

binding.source_set: Recomputed: all 9 files_sha256 entries match, no extra files apart from __pycache__ (excluded), and the set equals 3471c6ef.
binding.dependencies: darwin_spawn.c fd6dd36f, darwin_spawn.h 080c2e0c and the shim's source-validation.json 19a7d6c4 recompute equal. The shim set is c1a3bf82, the same as the supervisor's C_shim_source_set.
binding.interfaces: The record directory is PROBE_PREFIX + nonce, exactly the supervisor's exporter path. The caps (result.json at most 12287, transcripts at most 256) fit the frozen exporter's 16384/256. The exporter's directory and file checks (0700 directory, owner, 0600 files, nlink 1) match the parent's mkdir 0700 under umask 077, lstat check, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and fchmod 0600.

producer_checks.ambient_descriptors: PASS. AMBIENT_OPEN is open('/dev/null', O_RDONLY) with no O_CLOEXEC, and F_GETFD must show the flag clear (parent.c:288-293). AMBIENT_RECEIVED arrives through SCM_RIGHTS on a CLOEXEC, nonblocking DGRAM pair, with no MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC and no F_SETFD, and F_GETFD must show clear (59-117). Both are retired only after the shim call returns (308-310). Every owned descriptor must be below the scan bound (295), so a leak cannot fall outside the child's scan.
producer_checks.selected_endpoints: The INPUT, OUTPUT and ERROR pipes and the STATUS SOCK_STREAM pair are all CLOEXEC and O_NONBLOCK, with readback (probe_flags). The parent closes its copies of the child ends after the call, so EOF can arrive.
producer_checks.spawn_call_and_result: Exactly one chonk_darwin_spawn_v1 call, with fixed child path, argv[0] equal to that path, explicit argv '--nonce N --scan-limit bound' and envp LC_ALL=C only (271-302). Ownership is taken whenever child_created=1 and pid>0, even if the return was an error (304). Inconsistent created/pid values fail (305). Before the exchange, the version, all six error fields, duplicate_count 4 and requested==observed==0x400e are required (312-316). A compile-time _Static_assert also requires CLOEXEC_DEFAULT==0x4000 and the full set 0x400e (probe_common.h:31-33).
producer_checks.ownership_cleanup: check_wait uses waitpid(pid, WNOHANG) only and retries EINTR for at most 100 ms. ECHILD or other errors mark the child lost, after which it is never signalled again. cleanup_child: check, TERM, 250 ms, check, KILL, 1500 ms, then a reap-deadline failure (129-188). There is no waitpid(-1), no retry and no fallback. main fails on live, lost, unknown_rights_cleanup or created-but-unreaped; on a nonzero or signalled exit; and on any TERM or KILL (383-386).
producer_checks.exchange_and_report: Stdin writes are multiplexed with output drains and polls (10 ms) under the 8 s deadline. Output is capped at 256 bytes per channel and overflow is a failure. The parent's status parser requires exactly one LF-terminated frame, no NUL, 9 single-space tokens, canonical u32 values, pid equal to the owned pid, bound equal, low at most 15, extra at most bound-4 and first_errno at most INT32_MAX. Then low==15, extra==0, bits==0 and first_errno==0 are required (189-268).
producer_checks.records_and_close_errors: Transcripts are written, fsynced and closed with a checked close. All other roles are retired (close errors are recorded as owned_close) before final_record, so they appear in result.json. result.json is bounded at 12287 by snprintf overflow checks, written and fsynced. A failure there, or a failed close of result.json, produces a fixed stderr line and exit 1, so the run cannot certify itself (319-401). The error stage names are literals, and uname strings are compared but never interpolated.
producer_checks.child_inventory: Before any open or allocation, the child checks that its own RLIMIT_NOFILE soft limit equals argv bound (finite, 4 to 65536). It then checks F_GETFD over [0,bound): fds 0-3 build low_mask and must have CLOEXEC clear; any open fd at 4 or above counts as extra; an errno other than EBADF is a scan failure; the clock is checked every 64 fds. fds 0-2 must be FIFOs and fd 3 a connected AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM (getpeername plus SO_TYPE). It ignores SIGPIPE, sets nonblocking, reads the exact IN line through EOF, writes OUT and ERR, and sends one RESULT frame carrying distinct failure bits and the first errno (child.c).

independent_host_checks_scratch.root_tests: The 10 frozen tests (including 9 unsafe-source negative controls) were rerun on a scratch copy: OK.
independent_host_checks_scratch.classifier_bad_cases: I built my own consistent record (not root's fixture). evaluate() passes it. All 47 independent mutations fail. They cover: parent exit 1 or False; flags 0x000e, 0x400f or a mismatched observed value; stage 9; duplicate_count 3; a close failure; pid 0; child_created True or spawn_return False (bool typing); either ambient fd CLOEXEC; ambient not held; unknown rights; soft limit infinite, 3 or 65537; bound mismatch; hard below soft; hard infinite with a nonzero value; extra in the report or status frame; low 7; another pid; a foreign nonce; two frames; CRLF; a leading space; an extra stdout byte; stdout and stderr swapped; a false byte count; short input; raw status 9 or 256; TERM; lost; a wait error; a non-empty errors list; error overflow; an extra top-level key; a missing wait; a float pid; a string schema; darwin false; another child path; report valid false. strict_json rejected duplicate keys, NaN, trailing data, a BOM, invalid UTF-8, empty input and oversize input.
independent_host_checks_scratch.child_detector_on_host: A scratch copy of child.c, with only the Darwin #error guard removed and the 0x4000 constant defined, was compiled on Linux and spawned with explicit dup2 to 0-3 and RLIMIT 64. Clean: exit 0 with '15 0 0 0'. One leaked inheritable fd: extra=1, bit 4, exit 1. fd 3 as a pipe: bit 8. Wrong scan limit: bit 1. Wrong input: bit 32. This shows the detector counts a leaked descriptor and keeps the failure bits distinct. It is not Darwin evidence.

findings.P1_should_fix_nonblocking_inherited_stde: final_failure calls probe_flags(2,0), which sets O_NONBLOCK on the parent's inherited fd 2 and never restores it (parent.c:355). That fd most likely shares the supervisor's console or tty open file description, and the flag stays on that description after the parent exits. On a full tty output queue, ttwrite then returns EWOULDBLOCK. That can make the large closed export fail (the exporter treats a write error as rc 1) and make the supervisor's bash printf of STATUS fail under set -e. This happens only on the parent's failure paths (setup, record or result write/sync/close failure), so it cannot create a pass, but it can lose exactly the post-failure evidence the supervisor is meant to preserve. Fix: write the short diagnostic without changing descriptor flags (a bounded blocking write of 128 bytes or less), or save and restore F_GETFL. Changing it needs a new freeze; root decides.
findings.P2_held_by_position: ambient_held_through_spawn is set from code position (line 301), not from an F_GETFD check after the call. The only closes are the later retire() calls, so this is sound by source, but a post-call F_GETFD on both would make it observed.
findings.P3_vacuous_payload_byte_check: received_ambient sends from and receives into the same variable, which already holds 'F', so the byte!='F' test (line 103) cannot detect a wrong payload. n==1 and the rights checks are what matter.
findings.P4_sigchld_not_reset: The parent does not set SIGCHLD to SIG_DFL. If an inherited SIG_IGN or SA_NOCLDWAIT made XNU auto-reap, waitpid would give ECHILD and the run would be classified as lost, failing closed. That is a possible false negative, not a false pass.
findings.P5_classifier_has_no_expected_nonce: evaluate() checks internal consistency but takes no expected nonce. A self-consistent record set from another nonce passes evaluate() (verified on scratch). The nonce-named directory, the DL19 exporter's nonce binding and the supervisor's BEGIN and STATUS lines tie it to the run, but root's pipeline must explicitly require record nonce = export nonce = supervisor nonce. qualify.py reads a records directory, so it must be fed bytes reconstructed by the DL19 decoder, never original files (F4).
findings.P6_ambient_startup_descriptors: If PureDarwin dyld or libSystem initializers keep a descriptor open in the child before main, it counts as an extra and the run fails closed. That would be a possible false negative to diagnose separately, never relaxed.
findings.P7_budget: Worst-case parent time is about 8 s operation + 0.1 + 0.25 + 1.5 s reap + 0.5 s final, roughly 10.4 s, plus the exporter. The supervisor has no local timeout, so the host's 180 s bound must reserve this after the roughly 78 s bootstrap (as the criteria's runtime_budget says).

criteria_alignment: F5-F8 map onto fields the producer actually emits and the classifier enforces (ambient flags, finite bound, spawn fields with stage 10 and flags 0x400e, low 15 / extra 0 / bits 0, exact stdio and status, raw_status 0, no TERM/KILL, no errors). F1-F4 and F9 (artifacts, host boundary, foreground STATUS, closed export, recovery) remain root's binding and capture duties.
